integrity: Analytic proof presented; a standalone finite numerical checker supplements but does not prove universal quantifiers. Earlier intrinsic-volume formulas and published pi/3 counterexample explicitly acknowledged.
scientific_limitations: Sharp phase diagram only for four-dimensional circular cones with 0<alpha<pi/2; numerical root approximate; no extension to arbitrary cones or to degenerate endpoints. Priority claims provisional.
title: Sharp Poisson ultra-log-concavity threshold for four-dimensional circular cones
